subject: Update request: EFT owner change + warehouse shipping address
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@helixware.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@helixware.com
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to update EFT owner and ship-to warehouse address

Hi Tessa,

Hope you’re well — quick one from our side. We recently consolidated banking across our US legal entities. Can Redwood update the EFT/payee owner on file for HelixWare to: HelixWare Logistics LLC (EIN ending 4321) and route ACH to the new account? Also, we have a new primary ship-to for a subset of orders: 402 Industrial Way, Building C, Newark, CA 94560 (warehouse code: NWK-C).

I’ve attached a voided check and a completed W-9 for the new payee. If you need a signed vendor maintenance form, I can complete that and return it.

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Finance Operations
HelixWare
Direct: +1 415-555-0191

Attachments: helixware_voided_check.pdf (image/pdf), helixware_w9.pdf (pdf)

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@helixware.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update EFT owner and ship-to warehouse address

Thanks Oliver — we can do this but will need a completed vendor maintenance form (signed), the voided check, and an updated legal invoice remit name that matches your bank account. I reviewed the attachments you sent; the W-9 is good but the remit name on the W-9 currently reads "HelixWare Inc." while the bank is under "HelixWare Logistics LLC." Please confirm which legal entity should appear on invoices going forward and sign the vendor maintenance form so Finance can process the ACH change.

Next steps I recommend: 1) Oliver to confirm remit/legal invoicing name, 2) return signed vendor maintenance form (I’ve attached our form for convenience), 3) Finance (cc’d: Karthik) will run a verification and schedule the change to take effect on the next PO cycle.

I’ve attached the vendor maintenance form (blank) to this thread. Feel free to send the signed PDF back to this address.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Vendor Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
T: +1 206-555-0124

Attachment referenced: vendor_maintenance_form_request.pdf

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@helixware.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@helixware.com
Date: 2026-08-30T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update EFT owner and ship-to warehouse address

Tessa — thanks for the quick response. Sorry for the mismatch; HelixWare Logistics LLC is the correct remit entity for all future invoices tied to the logistics account. I’ve completed and signed the vendor maintenance form and attached it here, along with a copy of the corporate resolution naming Logistics LLC as the payee for banking purposes. Please let me know if you need anything else for bank change verification.

We also wanted to confirm: does Redwood require a new PO for orders that will ship to the Newark warehouse, or can we keep current open POs and just change the ship-to on a per-order basis? We don’t want to duplicate work on your side.

Regards,
Oliver
(attachments: vendor_maintenance_form_signed.pdf, helixware_resolution.pdf)

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@helixware.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to update EFT owner and ship-to warehouse address

All — quick update and final confirmation. I uploaded the signed vendor maintenance form and supporting docs to the vendor record (link above) and ran the initial verification with Finance. Karthik — can you confirm the verification result and whether we need any additional KYC for the entity change? If everything checks out I’ll schedule the EFT owner update effective 09-07 (next payment run) and update the payee name on HelixWare’s open POs.

Regarding ship-to: we can accept ship-to changes on a per-order basis; our procurement system will not require a new PO if the legal remit stays the same and the product SKU/location mapping is unchanged. For bulk changes across many POs we can script a mass-ship-to update, but that requires sign-off from Logistics (cc’d to internal operations).

Oliver — once Finance confirms, I’ll send a short confirmation email with the effective date and a note on how future POs will be handled. Thanks for the quick turnaround on the paperwork.

Best,
Tessa

--
Internal note: DO NOT change invoice remit until Finance signs off. Karthik, please escalate to Monica if any mismatch arises.
